name: Mesjillemit
title: The Priest's Mother
summary: Mesjillemit (also spelled Mesjillemot) is mentioned in 2 Chronicles as the mother of Berechiah and was associated with the Levitical priestly service. She is one of the women named in the genealogies in connection with temple service during the divided kingdom. Her descendants were among those who served in the temple in Jerusalem.
relatedPersons: Amasja, father of Josha, mentioned in Simeon's genealogy

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Levitical Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mesjillemit is mentioned as part of the Levitical lineage in connection with priestly service in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Service of the Descendants
keyEvents.description: Mesjillemit's descendants participated in temple service and in the administration of holy duties in Jerusalem.
